links.outcome: External validation of mortality model discrimination and calibration in a new country's ICU data
links.effect: GOSSIS-1 AUC 0.908, comparable to APACHE-III (0.908) and JROD (0.910); SMR 0.89 (95% CI 0.88-0.90) vs APACHE-II 0.39 and APACHE-III 0.46. Suboptimal calibration for neurologic and trauma categories.
links.quote: GOSSIS-1 demonstrates robust discrimination despite substantial geographic dataset shift but shows important calibration variations across disease categories.

links.outcome: Model calibration and performance drift over time including COVID-19 pandemic period
links.effect: Temporal stability 2015-2019, but performance deteriorated during COVID-19 in 2020 across disease categories, more pronounced for GOSSIS than APACHE-III.
links.quote: While the model showed temporal stability from 2015 to 2019, performance deteriorated during the COVID-19 pandemic, broadly reducing performance across disease categories in 2020.

links.outcome: Model performance under geographic dataset shift between development and local populations
links.effect: Despite demographic and clinical differences, GOSSIS-1 kept strong discrimination (AUC 0.908) but calibration varied by disease category.
links.quote: Despite the demographic and clinical differences of the validation cohort, GOSSIS-1 maintained strong discrimination, achieving an area under the curve of 0.908, comparable to APACHE-III (0.908) and JROD (0.910).

links.outcome: Comparison of GOSSIS-1 with APACHE-II, APACHE-III, and JROD on same data
links.effect: GOSSIS-1 calibration SMR 0.89 significantly better than APACHE-II (0.39) and APACHE-III (0.46), close to JROD (0.97); AUC comparable to APACHE-III and JROD.
links.quote: It also exhibited superior calibration, achieving a standardized mortality ratio (SMR) of 0.89 (95% CI, 0.88-0.90), significantly outperforming APACHE-II (SMR, 0.39; 95% CI, 0.39-0.40) and APACHE-III (SMR, 0.46; 95% CI, 0.46-0.47), and demonstrating a performance close to that of JROD (SMR, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.96-0.99).

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation evaluating geographic, temporal, and pandemic dataset shifts on mortality prediction models (GOSSIS-1 vs traditional severity scores).
